SELECT AS classCode, MAX(c.class_name) AS className, COUNT(DISTINCT p.student_id) AS studentTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.completed = 1 THEN p.student_id END) AS completedStudents, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS submittedProfiles, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'RETURNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returnedProfiles, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draftProfiles
GROUP BY ORDER BY className IS NULL, className

SELECT p.section_code AS sectionCode, p.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS profileCount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.student_id) AS studentCount
GROUP BY p.section_code, p.status
